arguments.message:
Hi there,

Please check the status of the scheduled report in **Settings → Reports → Scheduled**. The run‑history there will show whether the report is still running, has failed, or has been disabled. If the report appears to be running but you’re not receiving it, look at the recipient list – a bouncing email address can cause Meridian to pause delivery for that address while the report itself continues. Resolve any bounced addresses or re‑add the correct recipients, then the report should resume sending.

Let me know if you need any more help!
